KPI Description: Ensure all duty points are adequately staffed and proactively manage manpower requirements to avoid shortages.
Target: Manpower shortfall ≤ 2% of total site manpower

KPI Description: Submit the following month's employee leave plan with backfill arrangements on or before the 30th/31st of each month.
Identify and submit at least one site-specific improvement proposal and demonstrate its potential or actual impact.
Conduct and complete all scheduled site inspections according to the approved inspection roster.
Ensure all duty points maintain cleanliness, hygiene, and organization standards with supporting photographic evidence.
Conduct regular client visits, record feedback, address concerns, and prevent escalation of complaints.
Target: Zero client complaints escalated to management

KPI Description: Monitor employee conduct, discipline, responsiveness, and arrange corrective training when required.
Ensure positive participation of all assigned staff in company training programs and awareness sessions.
Maintain professional and cooperative relationships with superiors, peers, and subordinates.
Maintain regular attendance and availability to support operational requirements.
